title: FACTION MEMORY PASS PILOT
description: The patch claims to simplify progression, then decides whose confusion counts as acceptable loss. NPCs now remember a handful of faction choices and respond with small grudges instead of universal politeness. The upgrade flow now presents higher-value bundles at the exact moment players run out of patience.
consequence: The world developed a memory just large enough to be inconvenient. The economy found the pause between frustration and quitting.

title: FACTION MEMORY PASS RELIEF
description: The change decides which delays are atmosphere and which delays are invoices. NPCs now remember a handful of faction choices and respond with small grudges instead of universal politeness. Several paid shortcuts have been moved into baseline progression to reduce accusations of hostage design.
consequence: The world developed a memory just large enough to be inconvenient. Revenue meetings became quieter in the way elevators get quiet.

title: NARRATIVE COMPRESSION SPRINT PILOT
description: The feature moves a player-facing convenience into the same room as a business goal. Side stories now resolve faster so players can return to reward tracks before the mood becomes measurable. The upgrade flow now presents higher-value bundles at the exact moment players run out of patience.
consequence: The kingdom's grief was preserved as a tooltip and two currencies. The economy found the pause between frustration and quitting.
